SPELL_ABILITY.TARGET_DEFINITION: local filter = ClearFilter() filter:Add(FE_CONTROLLER, OP_IS, EffectController() ) filter:Add( FE_TYPE, OP_IS, CARD_TYPE_CREATURE )
SPELL_ABILITY.RESOLUTION_TIME_ACTION: local target = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0):Get_CardPtr(0) if target ~= nil then EffectDC():Get_Targets(0):Protect_CardPtr(0) target:Exile() end
local targetDC = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0) if targetDC ~= nil then local target = targetDC:Get_CardPtr(0) if target ~= nil then target:PutOntoBattlefield( EffectController() ) end end
